description: Operation-level knowledge for GH tools. Maps tool operations to gotchas, common mistakes, and context-aware hints.

wire.description: Connect output of one component to input of another

gotchas.message: Parameter names are case-sensitive. Use exact casing from component info.
Type conversion happens automatically for compatible types (e.g., Number to Integer). Incompatible types will show orange wire.
When wiring to list components (List Item, Tree Branch), wire to the List (L) input, not individual items.
Data tree mismatch may require Graft or Flatten component between source and target.

common_mistakes.correction: Query component info first to get exact parameter names
Check target expects numeric input, not geometry

common_mistakes.pattern: Wasp_Rules Generator (RuleGen) grammar mode (GR input, I4) produces 0 rules despite correctly formatted grammar text. Tested with: (1) multiline panel "upper > lower\nlower > upper", (2) two separate panels merged into a 2-item list ["upper > lower", "lower > upper"]. Both deliver correct data but RuleGen output is 0 rules. Disconnecting GR input (basic all-to-all mode) immediately produces 16 rules (4 connections x 4 = 16 permutations).
common_mistakes.correction: When grammar mode fails on Wasp_Rules Generator, fall back to basic all-to-all mode (disconnect GR input). The 16 all-to-all rules still allow aggregation to run. Grammar filtering may require a different Wasp version or undocumented input format. Alternative: manually create Wasp_Rule components instead of using RuleGenerator grammar mode.

common_mistakes.pattern: Wasp_Stochastic Aggregation has 10 inputs (PART=I0, PREV=I1, N=I2, RULES=I3, SEED=I4, CAT=I5, MODE=I6, GC=I7, ID=I8, RESET=I9), not 5. Miswiring Rules to I1 (PREV) or Seed to I3 (RULES) causes silent failures — the aggregation runs but produces wrong or no results.
common_mistakes.correction: Always verify Wasp component input indices from gh_snapshot before wiring. Key mappings: RULES→I3, SEED→I4, RESET→I9. Do not assume input order from component name or documentation — inspect the actual component.

common_mistakes.pattern: Wasp_Rules Generator GR input is I4 (not I1). I1 is SELF_P (boolean). Wiring grammar text to I1 causes "Type conversion failed from Text to bool" error.
common_mistakes.correction: RuleGen input mapping: PART=I0, SELF_P=I1 (bool), SELF_C=I2, TYP=I3, GR=I4 (grammar text). Always wire grammar text to I4.

common_mistakes.pattern: Replacing Wasp RuleGenerator with explicit Wasp_Rule components bypasses the grammar mode bug (0 rules from GR input). For N connection types with cross-type filtering (e.g., upper↔lower only), need 2*N*(N/2) directional rules. For 4 connections (2 upper, 2 lower), that's 8 rules.
common_mistakes.correction: Use individual Wasp_Rule components with a shared part-name Panel wired to all P1/P2 inputs, 4 index panels (0,1,2,3) wired to appropriate C1/C2 inputs, and a Merge component to collect all Rule outputs before feeding to Stochastic Aggregation I3 (RULES).

set_value.description: Set a value on a slider or panel

gotchas.message: Value must be within slider min/max bounds. Query component to check bounds first.
Component has an expression. Setting value may override or conflict with expression.
Integer sliders only accept whole numbers. Decimals will be truncated.

delete.description: Delete a component or object from the canvas

gotchas.message: Deleting a component also removes all wires connected to it.
Component is in a group. Delete removes from group but group remains.

disconnect.description: Remove a wire connection between components

gotchas.message: Must specify which parameter to disconnect. A component may have multiple inputs/outputs.
Parameter has multiple incoming wires. Disconnect removes one specific wire, not all.

create.description: Create a new component on the canvas

gotchas.message: Use component GUID from knowledge store, not display name. Name matching is unreliable across plugins.
Default position is 0,0. Place components with offset to avoid overlapping existing ones.
Component requires a plugin. If not installed, creation will fail silently or produce a placeholder.

common_mistakes.pattern: create by display name instead of GUID
common_mistakes.correction: Query gh_library or knowledge store for the correct GUID first
Offset each component by at least 200 units in X

common_mistakes.pattern: Wasp_Rule components cannot be created by GUID (964d036d-...) in gh_edit because Wasp uses ZuiPythonComponent as base type. The GUID from the knowledge store is the Wasp-internal ID, not the GH componentGuid.
common_mistakes.correction: Create Wasp_Rule by name: {"name": "Wasp_Rule"} in gh_edit create. Name-based resolution works for all Wasp components. The component has 4 inputs: P1(I0), C1(I1), P2(I2), C2(I3) and 1 output: R(O0). Rules are directional — need both A→B and B→A for bidirectional connectivity.

move.description: Move or reposition components on the canvas

gotchas.message: Coordinates are absolute canvas position, not relative offset. Query current position first if adjusting.
Moving a grouped component moves it independently. Move the group to keep layout.

common_mistakes.correction: Use gh_query to get current bounds before repositioning

gotchas.message: Group requires a list of component GUIDs. Query canvas first to get instance IDs.
Groups are visual only. Clusters encapsulate components into a single callable unit with exposed parameters.

common_mistakes.correction: Only group logically related components to keep canvas readable

query.description: Query canvas state, component info, or connections

gotchas.message: Large canvases may return many components. Use filters (type, name) to narrow results.
Canvas state reflects last solve. If a component has errors, its outputs may be stale.

explore.description: Deep exploration of component behavior, constraints, or data flow

gotchas.message: Volatile components (Random, Timer) produce different outputs each solve. Pin values before exploring.
Data tree structure affects downstream behavior. Check branch counts and path structure, not just values.

reference.description: Set or get referenced Rhino geometry on a GH component

gotchas.message: Referenced object must exist in Rhino document. Deleted objects will cause null data errors.
Reference type must match component expectation. A Curve parameter won't accept a Brep reference.
Use Rhino object GUID (from rhino_objects), not GH component instance ID.

common_mistakes.pattern: use GH instance ID instead of Rhino object GUID
common_mistakes.correction: Query rhino_objects for the geometry GUID, then pass to gh_set_reference

document.description: Open or create Grasshopper definition files

gotchas.message: Opening a new document discards unsaved changes on current canvas. Save first if needed.
Definition may use plugin components not installed locally. Missing plugins cause red components.

inspect_output.description: Inspect the output values and data structure of a component

gotchas.message: Null outputs usually mean upstream error or missing input. Check gh_errors before debugging values.
Output may be a data tree with multiple branches. Path indices matter for downstream wiring.

investigate.description: Investigate errors, failed solutions, or unexpected behavior

gotchas.message: Errors cascade downstream. Always check the earliest red/orange component first.
Most runtime errors are data type or tree structure mismatches. Check input types and paths.

canvas_cleanup.description: Auto-arrange or clean up canvas layout

gotchas.message: Cleanup rearranges positions but preserves all connections. Wire order may change visually.
